body: Update 9am: Adds company confirmation.Apollo Global Inc. APO agreed to take a minority equity stake in Mubadala Capital, the alternative asset management arm of Mubadala Investment Company.Apollo APO and additional strategic investors are expected to commit an aggregate $5 billion to Mubadala Capital’s investment strategies at initial close, according to a statement on Monday.“Mubadala has been a trusted partner in seeding and scaling a number of our strategies over the years, Apollo Co-President John Zito said in the statement. "This investment in the differentiated asset management platform they have built in Mubadala Capital builds on our existing partnership and reflects our conviction in their business."Apollo joins the founders of Silver Rock Financial as an equity holder in Mubadala Capital. Mubadala Investment Company remains the majority shareholder.The transaction is expected to close in Q4.CNBC earlier Monday reported that Apollo would take a 10% stake in Mubadala Capital.Mubadala Capital advises and administers over $755 billion in assets or clients and limited partners through its core alternatives business and strategic partnership.Goldman Sachs & Jefferies served as financial advisors, and Skadden, Arps served as legal counsel to Mubadala Capital. Morgan Stanley served as financial advisor, and Paul Weiss served as legal counsel to Apollo.DisclaimerContent provided by Seeking Alpha is intended for information purposes only, and that Seeking Alpha does not offer any personalist investment advice and is not a licensed securities dealer, broker, US investment adviser or investment bank.

p: Apollo Global Inc. APO는 Mubadala Capital의 지분 10%를 매입하기 위한 계약을 마무리하고 있다. CNBC의 Scott Wapner의 보고서에 따르면 이 발표는 월요일에 발표될 예정이다. Apollo는 아부다비에서 15년 동안 일하고 있다. Apollo는 이미 Mubadala Capital의 모회사와 대규모 파트너십을 맺고 있다. 거래 조건은 알려지지 않았다. Mubadala Capital은 7,550억 달러 이상을 조언하고 관리한다. Mubadala와 Apollo는 CNBC에 대한 논평을 거부했다. 개발 이야기 ...Seeking Alpha가 제공하는 면책 조항은 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 Seeking Alpha는 개인적인 투자 조언을 제공하지 않으며 허가받은 증권 딜러, 중개인, 미국 투자 고문 또는 투자 은행이 아닙니다.
